name: – Emma Ytterell – Article 7, after § 5 – Am 99
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on speeding-up environmental assessments
part_text: 5a. Competent authorities may decide to adapt the time limits provided for in this Article on a case-by-case basis where they consider it necessary to ensure the integrity and completeness of the environmental assessment.
